notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (sales engagement platform) evaluating Redwood for outbound SDR agent + calendar/email automation. Wants to start on Hosted API to validate streaming SLOs and tool-calling reliability, then move to Dedicated if throughput/cost justifies it.

Key technical asks/requirements (from product + infra leads):
- Low-latency streaming for agent responses; emphasis on UX: tokens should stream within perceived realtime. Quote: "user should see reply start within 200ms and average token latency <100ms".
- Tool calling to perform CRM updates, send emails via SMTP/Gmail API, and create calendar invites (Google Calendar). Must support robust retry/fallthrough and idempotency for actions.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin console, KMS integration for key policy, audit logs retained 2 years, retention controls per customer policy.
- Data residency: prefer US-only region for PII; will ask about Private later for full isolation.
- Model preferences: open to Llama-2-derived and Mistral-type variants; want Redwood's recommended latency/cost tradeoffs and quantization suggestions.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement; wants predictable monthly commit if Dedicated is proposed.

POC details:
- 2-week Hosted POC (staging) that integrates streaming endpoints + tool calling adapter to their sandbox CRM. SE will configure KV/prefix caching to measure token-cost reduction. Load profile: 250 concurrent agents during peak; avg session length 120 tokens.
- Success criteria: streaming start <200ms, 95th pct per-token latency <120ms, tool-call success rate >99% under load, end-to-end response time for typical outbound flow <1.2s.

- VP Product: "We can tolerate slightly higher token cost if the UX is smooth — streaming matters."
- SRE: "We need to see audit logs and key handling before any production Dedicated commitment."
